Use when user needs to find, check availability, or book local services like plumbers, electricians, cleaners, mechanics, barbers, personal trainers, etc. Triggers on requests like "book me a haircut", "find a plumber near me", "I need a smog check", "schedule a massage", or any local service request. 75+ service categories available.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Lokuli MCP 预订现实生活服务。适用于用户需要查找、查询档期或预订水管工、电工、清洁工、技工、理发师、私人教练等本地服务的场景。当收到“帮我理发”、“附近水管工”、“需要烟雾检查”、“预约按摩”或其他本地服务请求时触发。支持 75 种以上的服务类别。
skills.name: Lokuli Booking

skills.description: Book color services through Lokuli MCP. Use when user needs to find and book color. Triggers on requests like "book a color", "find color near me", or any color service request.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Lokuli MCP 预约染发服务。当用户需要查找或预约染发时使用，触发词包括“预约染发”、“查找附近的染发服务”或任何染发服务请求。
skills.name: Book Color

skills.description: Multi-Cursor orchestration for parallel task execution and AI council deliberation. Use when needing to run multiple Cursor agents in parallel, coordinate complex multi-step coding tasks, get diverse perspectives from different AI models (Opus/Sonnet/GPT) on technical decisions, or synthesize multi-agent discussions into actionable recommendations.
skills.description_zh: 多游标编排实现并行任务执行和AI议会审议。在需要并行运行多个游标代理、协调复杂多步编码任务、从不同AI模型（Opus/Sonnet/GPT）获取技术决策的多样观点，或将多智能体讨论综合为可执行建议时使用。
